name: tmdb
title: TMDB
summary: The Movie Database API v3: movie details and credits, popular, search, discover, genres, TV series, people and configuration, with placeholder posters for image.tmdb.org and rate-limit, not-found, invalid-key and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: TMDB's OpenAPI file (developer.themoviedb.org) is offered under the TMDB API Terms of Use, which do not allow redistribution, so nothing is pinned; the subset follows the public reference by hand and uses its page slugs as operation ids.
